description: Full-image threshold coverage audit using the same seven explicit fields as region measurement; not semantic coverage.

image_path.description: Explicitly authorized absolute local regular PNG/JPEG file; final symlinks rejected where O_NOFOLLOW exists; parent links resolve normally.

roi.description: [left,top,right,bottom]; right/bottom exclusive; nonempty, within image; at most 1 million pixels. Full-image effective transparency anywhere rejects this audit; unlike ROI-only measurement, no opaque-ROI exemption.

rgb_min.description: Decoded RGB lower bounds; no color management.

rgb_max.description: Decoded RGB upper bounds; each >= matching lower bound.

saturation_min.description: Inclusive HSV S threshold: (maxRGB-minRGB)/maxRGB; black S=0.

min_area.description: Retain connected regions with at least this many matched pixels; all discarded regions counted. Retained for compatibility only: this full-image pixel audit does not compute/filter connected components.

connectivity.description: 4 uses shared edges; 8 also joins diagonal neighbors. Retained for compatibility only: this full-image pixel audit does not compute/filter connected components.
